title: Authorization Boundary Finalization — Option A Selected
context: UNKNOWN Closure Audit (docs/audit/AUTHORIZATION_BOUNDARY_UNKNOWN_CLOSURE_AUDIT_20260924.md) completed with full runtime verification. All effect surfaces classified. Three Authorization Boundary scope options presented to きむら博士. Human Decision required to finalize institutional boundary definition.

alternatives.rejected_reason: Telemetry/Recording paths (gateway, connector_caliber, event_buffer, PHI-OS Event Gate) do not perform governance state-changing effects. Adding authorization binding to these paths would conflate authorization decision with event recording, violating institutional separation principle. Unnecessary complexity without corresponding security benefit.

Hybrid approach creates ambiguous boundary between gateway/connector (treated as authorization-bound telemetry) and event_buffer/PHI-OS Gate (treated as non-authorization-bound persistence). Introduces asymmetry requiring maintenance of distinction between 'authorized telemetry' and 'non-authorized telemetry', adding cognitive/operational burden without clear security requirement.

decision: Authorization Boundary = MCP Protected Tools Only (6 tools: mocka_add_todo, mocka_update_todo, mocka_write_event, mocka_decision_write, mocka_integrity_write, mocka_seal). Explicitly excludes: gateway.post_event, connector_caliber, event_buffer, PHI-OS Event Gate, governance/write_path/*, orchestrator/*. Institutional separation: Telemetry/Recording/Event Persistence ≠ Human Authorization Target.
rationale: Fact-based audit (UNKNOWN Closure Audit) verified: (1) MCP Protected Tools: 6-attribute authorization binding implemented, working, verified; (2) External AI paths: API key authentication sufficient for telemetry recording, governance state NOT modified; (3) Inactive paths: governance/write_path and orchestrator unreachable from active runtime. Rationale aligns with governance_pipeline.py:33-58 design intent (READ_ONLY_TOOLS vs WRITE_TOOLS distinction).
impact: Scope: Current Runtime only. Authorization Boundary defined as MCP Protected Tools 6 total. Implementation: NO code changes required. Existing 6-attribute authorization binding unchanged. Testing: mocka_mcp_server.py:509-1143 GL7 validation layer remains active. Future Condition: If External AI Connector or Gateway confirmed to perform state-changing effects (Governance state, Business-critical state, Decision Ledger modification), separate Human Decision required for that surface. This Decision does NOT provide blanket authorization for future state-changing connectors.
